content.text: The current implementation imposes several restrictions beyond the requirements: a Friday cutoff, lunch exclusion, post-event buffers, 15-minute start intervals, and durations divisible by 30. I’ll remove those, keep the existing 09:00–17:00 working hours, and make the day parameter informational only.
